authority: CSS September 2025 measures and the project decision record for the live demo

measures.title: Financial assistance application posted
measures.evidence_requirement: Document links and completed searches on the applicable landing pages; any accessible application suffices.

measures.title: Plain-language policy summary posted
measures.evidence_requirement: Direct link to an accessible designated summary, or a documented complete search.

measures.title: Policy statement posted
measures.evidence_requirement: Direct link to an accessible designated statement, or a documented complete search. Outdated text alone does not establish absence.

measures.title: Posted materials are consistent
measures.evidence_requirement: Compare like terms across all applicable materials including online applications. Identify conflicts and gaps.

measures.title: Primary service-area boundaries comply
measures.evidence_requirement: Published service counties and a dated applicable authority for this facility's required counties.

measures.title: No application submission deadline
measures.evidence_requirement: Distinguish a time limit for submitting applications from collection or processing intervals.

measures.title: No asset-based eligibility check
measures.evidence_requirement: Review eligibility provisions for required asset tests, including exceptions.

measures.title: Immigration status is not a barrier
measures.evidence_requirement: Review immigration eligibility restrictions separately from optional demographic fields.

measures.title: Entire NYS Uniform Application used
measures.evidence_requirement: Compare the whole designated form with its versioned official template, including required sections and customization questions.

measures.title: Application contact information provided
measures.evidence_requirement: Cite the application-assistance contact and usable contact channel.

measures.title: Income and discount tables included
measures.evidence_requirement: Identify both the income thresholds and the discount table in the application.

measures.title: Correct FPL year and dollar amounts
measures.evidence_requirement: Compare the published annual USD year and household-size cells to the pinned HHS table. A complete profile covers sizes 1–8 at 200/300/400%.

measures.title: Eligibility through at least 400% FPL
measures.evidence_requirement: Explicit eligibility limit and the scope of exclusions; a table heading alone does not establish eligibility.

measures.title: Monthly installments capped at 5% of gross income
measures.evidence_requirement: Explicit cap on monthly installments as a percentage of gross monthly income, distinct from interest.

measures.title: Summary describes primary service area
measures.evidence_requirement: Cite the service-area description in the plain-language summary.

measures.title: Summary explains application process
measures.evidence_requirement: Cite the route or instructions for submitting an application in the designated summary.

measures.title: Summary specifies assistance income levels
measures.evidence_requirement: Cite explicit assistance income levels in the designated summary.

results.yes: Verified observation satisfies the measure across its applicable scope.
results.no: Verified contradiction or documented complete posting search.
results.unclear: Incomplete, incompatible, conflicting or unavailable evidence; report as unresolved.
results.n_a: Requires an approved exemption and denominator rule. This version authorizes none.

unresolved_policy: Retain all 17 measures. Report possible grades across unresolved findings and disputed overrides; withhold a final grade for any unresolved finding, missing authorization or applicable policy uncertainty.
